name: av-rust-desktop-app-builder
description: Agent skills for building native Rust desktop apps with Tauri 2 and a React + TypeScript webview frontend: a layered Cargo workspace, a headless engine where every action is a command over immutable snapshots, a thin frontend that draws what the engine publishes, desktop + CLI + agent control channel from one core, and a single `cargo xtask ci` gate. Ships a buildable project template and setup scripts.
author: avatsaev
